requirement: Website Opportunities hand-off on an EmDash site: media.upload goes through tracy-host into the site's own media library (no token in tracy-web), refusals and unreachable hosts are told apart, a duplicate upload is audit-only, and the QA gate holds an Astro content-hashed stylesheet by its stem across a rebuild

oracle.ref: PR #1427 (feat); fix evidence: em-marigold1 on stand wo, 18/10/2026 (tasks/evidence-wo-emdash.md): 24/24 pictures into the EmDash library in 7 s, a re-upload answered deduplicated; the QA gate then failed css-intact only because Astro renamed _astro/Base.BNyaLx3F.css to Base.DVyY2jn1.css after the agent's site.rebuild (205 → 206 rules).
oracle.invariant: apps/tracy-web/test/apply-emdash-media.test.mjs: an owner's media.upload on an EmDash site reaches POST /_host/emdash-media with the file name, type and base64, answers {ok, id, url, path: url, deduplicated} and writes one site_write ok row; a viewer is refused at the toolset gate before the host; a path that names no picture is INVALID_MEDIA 400 before the host; a clean no from the site is recorded refused and frees the write lease; a host with no readable answer is 502 EMDASH_MEDIA_UNREACHABLE, recorded unknown, the lease kept; bytes the library already holds are answered ok with deduplicated: true, leave no site_write row and do not move last_write_at. apps/tracy-host/test/emdash-media.test.mjs: the in-container MCP script is byte for byte the site tools' own; the upload runs media_upload in <label>-web-1 with the bytes on stdin; the same bytes again come back as the existing item; not-EmDash, a non PNG/JPEG/WebP type, bytes that are not that type, too large and a bad name are refused before docker runs; the site's refusals are named (no token, tool said no, HTTP error, nothing readable). apps/tracy-host/test/demo-qa.test.mjs: css-intact holds _astro/<Name>.<hash>.css and assets/<name>-<hash>.css by stem — a rebuild that keeps the rules passes, half the rules lost or a sentinel gone in the new file still fails. vendor/tracy/tracy-website-opportunities/test/domain-agent-prompt.test.mjs: the EmDash hand-off prompt names the media library url of each picture, tells the agent to write content with tracy_emdash content_update, to restyle through look.set then one site.rebuild, and never to write a literal \n.
